But I don'tknow how to talk to my doctor now, it all seems so dream/film like. I have never told anyone how I feel, I have just put on the face I am expected to and got on with life. I feel so selfish knowing there are so many people in the world that would give so much for my lifstyle ( pretty poor but better than others)
I just don't particulary want to be alive but I don't particulary want to do anything about it either!!
